bloom_rift_acolyte: Signe: Sabeline tells me which flower was whose. I wish she would stop.
bloom_rift_acolyte_defeat: Signe: Still standing. The flowers are disappointed.
bloom_rift_acolyte_intro: Signe: Lie down in the bloom. Just for a moment. Everyone does, eventually.
bloom_rift_sign: A field of pale flowers under a sky that never finishes getting dark. Every flower turns to watch you.

lines: Black water wells up between the roots. It is warm, like breath.
Your Spirlings drink and rest.

breathing_bog_bogwalker: Kjell: I walk the bog on stilts. My brother walked it without. Only one of us still walks.
breathing_bog_bogwalker_intro: Kjell: Stand still. It's easier for both of us.
breathing_bog_peatcutter: Ragna: Feel that? The ground just breathed in. Don't be standing here when it breathes out.
breathing_bog_peatcutter_defeat: Ragna: Fine. The bog will have you later. It's patient.
breathing_bog_peatcutter_intro: Ragna: I cut peat. Today I cut corners.
candle_causeway_candlebearer: Ylva: I carry candles to the Choir. If one goes out on the way, the person it's for gets a bad week.
candle_causeway_candlebearer_defeat: Ylva: Still lit. Maudrey won't like that.
candle_causeway_candlebearer_intro: Ylva: Hold this candle while we fight. It's yours.
candle_causeway_tollwick: Oda: Toll is one candle stub per crossing. Or one wick. Or one finger, I'm flexible.
candle_causeway_tollwick_defeat: Oda: Toll waived. I'll charge the next one double.
candle_causeway_tollwick_intro: Oda: No stub? Then we settle it the old way.
driftwick_bunk_raft_sleeper: Bunk Keeper Sanna: Sleep tight. Tie your bunk to the floor. Tie the floor to something.
driftwick_chart_room_cartographer: Chart Keeper Lorne: This map shows where Driftwick was last Tuesday. It sells best to the ones who want to miss it.
driftwick_folk_1: Pole Man Rudd: I push the town with a long pole. Nobody tells me where. I just push.
driftwick_folk_2: Fishwife Marit: My raft drifted off with my husband on it. I waved. He waved. It was the best day of our marriage.
driftwick_folk_3: Anchor Smith Dag: I forge anchors. Corran buys them, then sells where we won't be.

lines: Raft Medic Sorrel: Hold still. The town moves enough for both of us.

driftwick_net_shed_netter: Net Mender Yrsa: I catch fish by day and neighbours by night. The neighbours fall off more.
driftwick_pole_house_poleman: Pole Master Ebbe: We steer the town by vote. The vote is whoever holds the longest pole.
driftwick_sign: Driftwick. Address changes nightly. Post is not delivered.

lines: Raft Trader Mott: Buy now. By noon my stall is in another town and so is your change.
driftwick_trader.action: shop strong_tonic max_tonic remedy cooling_gel wake_bell revival_leaf dash_brew guard_brew pith_mend pith_clear

gloamwater_bloomthief: Rasmus: I steal blooms from Lastbloom and sell them back to Lastbloom. Sabeline takes a cut. Of me.
gloamwater_bloomthief_defeat: Rasmus: Fine. Take a bloom. Don't ask whose it was.
gloamwater_bloomthief_intro: Rasmus: You saw nothing. Let me help you forget.
gloamwater_gloamferry: Una: I ferry the dead across the gloam. The living cost extra, they keep asking questions.
gloamwater_gloamferry_defeat: Una: Paid. Sit at the front. The back is for the other passengers.
gloamwater_gloamferry_intro: Una: Pay the ferry in battle. Coins sink.
heaving_fields_betbroker: Sigge: I run bets for Reeve Ashby. You're at nine to one. Against.
heaving_fields_betbroker_defeat: Sigge: Eight to one now. Still against. Ashby hates surprises.
heaving_fields_betbroker_intro: Sigge: If I beat you, the odds get better. For me.
heaving_fields_heaver: Gorm: The fields heave at noon. Farmers here plant at dawn and harvest wherever the crop lands.
heaving_fields_heaver_defeat: Gorm: You kept your feet. Rare. The ground will be cross.
heaving_fields_heaver_intro: Gorm: Brace yourself. The ground does the first punch.
hymnmarsh_hummer: Ilse: We hum instead of singing. The marsh learns the words and then it sings back. Badly.
hymnmarsh_hummer_defeat: Ilse: Off key. Like everyone who wins here.
hymnmarsh_hummer_intro: Ilse: Hum along. Or scream. The marsh likes both.
hymnmarsh_rootpicker: Arvid: I pick roots for Ossian's tea. Some roots pick back.
hymnmarsh_rootpicker_defeat: Arvid: Don't tell Ossian. He'll feed me to the chapel.
hymnmarsh_rootpicker_intro: Arvid: Ossian said to slow you down. He didn't say how.
lastbloom_flower_house_florist: Flower Seller Gesine: The roses this year are very red. Last year was a bad year for wanderers.
lastbloom_folk_1: Flower Picker Joss: I pick the blooms with gloves. The last picker did not. He is a bloom now.
lastbloom_folk_2: Bouquet Binder Edel: Every bouquet gets a ribbon and a name tag. Not the buyer's name.
lastbloom_folk_3: Old Lamplighter Brun: Nell Tallis used to bring me oil. Now she brings me news. The news is worse.

lines: Florist Ysolde: Rest among the blooms. They smell sweet. Try not to wonder why.

lastbloom_lamp_room_lamplighter: Lamp Boy Ivo: Nell borrowed our best lamp. She said she would bring it back lit.
lastbloom_press_room_presser: Flower Presser Dorle: I press the blooms flat in old books. Sometimes the books are diaries.
lastbloom_seed_store_seedkeeper: Seed Keeper Hale: Every seed has a name tag. I am not allowed to read them out.
lastbloom_sign: Lastbloom. Flowers for sale. No refunds, no questions, no roots.
mossgate_folk_1: Peat Cutter Arn: I cut the peat at dawn. By dusk it has grown back. So has my debt.
mossgate_folk_2: Mossgate Widow Lise: My husband went out to see if the bog was breathing. It was. He isn't.
mossgate_folk_3: Old Reeve's Clerk Oswin: Reeve Ashby keeps a book of bets. Your name is in it. The odds are not kind.

lines: Bog Nurse Hedda: Lie down on the moss. It is warm because something under it is breathing.

mossgate_moss_inn_innkeeper: Innkeeper Bertil: Room's free. The moss in the bed charges by the hour.
mossgate_peat_shed_cutter: Peat Stacker Nils: Dry peat burns. Wet peat breathes. Keep them apart.
mossgate_reeve_hall_clerk: Reeve's Clerk Tibbet: The reeve is out. He is always out when someone owes him a candle.
mossgate_rope_loft_roper: Ropemaker Agna: The winch man buys my rope by the metre and cuts it by the half metre.
mossgate_sign: Mossgate. Mind the moss. It minds you back.

lines: Chandler Pim: Candles, tonics, rope. The rope is new. The last batch let someone down.
mossgate_trader.action: shop strong_tonic max_tonic remedy cooling_gel wake_bell revival_leaf dash_brew guard_brew pith_mend pith_clear

lines: Reeve Bram Ashby of Mossgate hires you to quiet the four Rifts that make the moor breathe. He pays in candles. Everyone here does.
Nell Tallis: I pilot rafts and I know every path before it moves. First job: the Wick Rift under Tallowmere, south gate.
Nell Tallis: Trust me. Everyone here does, at least once.

nell_after: The winch man cut the rope ten metres short to save the haul back up. He billed Halcyra for a Wayfarer lost to the bog. The bog was soft. His invoice was not.
Nell: Don't look at me like that. The winch man cuts every rope short. I only steer.
raft_rift_acolyte: Joran: Corran pays me to tell the town where it will be. I am wrong on purpose. He pays more for that.
raft_rift_acolyte_defeat: Joran: Corran is on the last raft. Don't step where he points.
raft_rift_acolyte_intro: Joran: You're standing on the wrong raft. All of them are wrong.
raft_rift_sign: Loose rafts drift in a circle over water with no bottom. The Rift pulls the town here every night.

lines: Black water wells up between the roots. It is warm, like breath.
Your Spirlings drink and rest.

rootchapel_almshouse_elder: Almsman Teodor: We get bread on Sundays. The roots get the rest of us on Mondays.
rootchapel_bell_cellar_ringer: Bell Ringer Grit: The bell rang by itself last night. The roots are learning.
rootchapel_folk_1: Choirboy Fen: We used to sing hymns. Now we hum, so the roots cannot learn the words.
rootchapel_folk_2: Pilgrim Hesta: I walked three weeks to pray here. The chapel ate my shoes on the first night.
rootchapel_folk_3: Gravedigger Ulf: I dig the graves. The roots fill them. We have an understanding.
rootchapel_herb_room_herbalist: Herbalist Minna: Root tea calms the nerves. It also roots the drinker. Small print.

lines: Sexton Wilm: Sit in the pew. If a root wraps your ankle, that means it likes you.

rootchapel_sign: Rootchapel. Services daily. The roots attend every one.
rootchapel_vestry_priest: Curate Anselm: Ossian took the pulpit. The roots took Ossian. I took the collection box.
tallowmere_chandlery_chandler: Chandler Osk: Short candles for the old, long candles for the young. Medium for the ones Maudrey dislikes.
tallowmere_choir_dorm_singer: Choir Singer Wenzel: We sing for the candles at night. The candles never clap.
tallowmere_folk_1: Wick Girl Ama: I trim the wicks so they burn slower. Maudrey says I am bad for business.
tallowmere_folk_2: Mourner Kell: I come every day to watch my brother's candle. It is very short now. So is my patience.
tallowmere_folk_3: Tallow Boiler Gunda: The best tallow comes from the bog. Do not ask from what in the bog.

lines: Choir Sister Brede: Rest under the candles. If one goes out, do not look at whose name it is.

tallowmere_name_hall_scribe: Wax Scribe Rhoda: I carve the names into the wax. Spelling mistakes burn just the same.
tallowmere_sign: Tallowmere. One candle per soul. Bring your own wick.
tallowmere_tallow_kitchen_boiler: Tallow Cook Harl: Stir slowly. Fast stirring brings things up from the bottom of the pot.

lines: Wax Seller Tobin: Tonics on the shelf, candles by the name. Yours is on special.
tallowmere_trader.action: shop strong_tonic max_tonic remedy cooling_gel wake_bell revival_leaf dash_brew guard_brew pith_mend pith_clear

taproot_rift_acolyte: Malte: Ossian says the moor must eat. I volunteered to help. Not to be eaten. To help.
taproot_rift_acolyte_defeat: Malte: Ossian is just past the roots. He's been saying grace for an hour.
taproot_rift_acolyte_intro: Malte: Dinner is served. You're the dinner.
taproot_rift_sign: Roots as thick as pews grow through the floor. They hum the hymns nobody sings any more.

lines: Black water wells up between the roots. It is warm, like breath.
Your Spirlings drink and rest.

wandering_wood_mapseller: Bodo: Fresh maps! Accurate until sunset. After that, accurate for somewhere else.
wandering_wood_mapseller_defeat: Bodo: Here, a free map. It's wrong. Consider it a lesson.
wandering_wood_mapseller_intro: Bodo: You didn't buy a map. Now you're lost and I'm offended.
wandering_wood_oakwatcher: Tilde: I count the oaks every night. One more step each. Last week one stepped on a tent.
wandering_wood_oakwatcher_defeat: Tilde: The oaks liked that. They moved closer to you.
wandering_wood_oakwatcher_intro: Tilde: The oaks are watching. Let's give them a show.

lines: Driftwick unmoors at night and goes wherever the Raft Rift pulls it. Warden Corran sells the morning position to whoever pays most.
Ashby cut Driftwick's anchor lines with you aboard. Your candle was still burning and he had bet against it. He hates losing money more than he hates you.

warden_corran_defeat: Fine, the Rift is yours. The town drifts on without it. I already sold where it lands.
warden_corran_intro: Tomorrow's position of Driftwick costs a hundred. Yours, tonight, costs everything. Pick a raft.

lines: The Tallow Choir lights a candle for every soul the moor takes. Warden Maudrey keeps the Wick Rift and lights hers in advance.
A candle with your name was lit the day you arrived. Maudrey sold its burn time to Reeve Ashby, who opened a book on how long you would last.

warden_maudrey_defeat: Still burning. How tiresome. I will have to sell the candle back to myself.
warden_maudrey_intro: I lit a candle for you this morning. Do not thank me. I lit it early so the wax would be ready for the next one.

lines: The roots have eaten half the chapel and all of the congregation's patience. Warden Ossian preaches that the moor must be fed.
Nell, your raft pilot and only friend on the moor, steered you to the chapel on Ossian's orders. The roots are fed on a schedule. You were the schedule.

warden_ossian_defeat: The roots will forgive you. I will not. Go with their blessing, they never ask mine.
warden_ossian_intro: The moor is hungry, child. I only set the table. You came at dinner time.

lines: The moor flowers over everything it swallowed. Warden Sabeline waits in the bloom with Ashby's betting book and an offer to split the winnings.
Nell comes back with a lamp and an apology and leads you out of the bloom. At the edge she blows the lamp out. You find your own way home. She had sold the book twice already.

warden_sabeline_defeat: Take the Rift. The bloom closes tonight. Whatever is still standing in it stays for next year.
warden_sabeline_intro: Every flower here grew out of someone who trusted the wrong person. Pick one. I will tell you whose it was.
wick_rift_acolyte: Brenna: Maudrey lit a candle for me when I joined. It is very short. I try not to think about it.
wick_rift_acolyte_defeat: Brenna: Go on. Maudrey has a fresh wick ready for you.
wick_rift_acolyte_intro: Brenna: Your candle is burning. Let's see how fast.
wick_rift_sign: Ten thousand wicks stand in black water. Each one waits for a name.

lines: Black water wells up between the roots. It is warm, like breath.
Your Spirlings drink and rest.
A basket lowers you off the edge of Halcyra on a rope that has been mended more times than it has been paid for. The winch man charges by the metre. Stopping costs extra.
Winch Man: Quivermoor? Down the rope. Paid by the metre. Your heirs get the bill for the rest.
